d: Long, flowing charcoal-grey hair with straight bangs and a gold hair accessory is paired with large, expressive amber eyes. The face appears as a mature adolescent with a slender, petite build. The outfit consists of a white miko-style wrap top with red trim, a red pleated mini-skirt with white ruffled undershorts, a black waist sash, and thigh-high black stockings with brown leather straps. Large, grey mechanical naval gun batteries are positioned behind the figure.
